select top 10 DEP.* from dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_CM216_View DEP
inner join dw.dimcustomeraccount_CM216_20231213 DCA
on DCA.accountSK = DEP.accountsk
inner join dw.dimcustomer DC
ON dca.customersk = DC.customerSK
where DEP.balanceamountfull_original > 0
and DC.customerID like 'C%'
;

select * from dw.dimcustomeraccount_CM216_20231213
where accountsk in(4501186,5340921,4213707,2084061);

DEP R02451517,R02045122,C00148757

select top 10 LNS.* from dw.ViewRBBLoanAccount_CM216_20231213 LNS
inner join dw.dimcustomer DC
ON LNS.customersk = DC.customerSK
where LNS.DueForTheMonthFull_Original Is not NULL
and LNS.DueForTheMonthFull_Original > 0
and LNS.ProductGroup is Not NULL
and DC.customerID like 'C%'
;
